start: Profile, Body screen, one earlier waist entry

user_sees: Screen 'Add measures', 'Fill in any you like.'
A Date row set to today, boxes for Body weight and each measure, the last value as a grey hint
must_not: Another person's or the gym's value typed into a box as if the member typed it
An empty hint where an earlier entry exists

user_sees: A success buzz; back on Body, History shows the waist entry for today
must_not: Two waist values for the same day
A cm value stored as inches or the other way round

user_sees: 'Add measures' with the Waist box first
must_not: Body weight first when the member came from Waist

steps.action: Tap Date, pick yesterday in the 'Date' sheet, type a value, Save
user_sees: The entry saved on yesterday's day in History
must_not: A picture added before the day change left on the old day

steps.action: Type 0 or letters in Waist, tap Save
user_sees: Pop-up 'Check the numbers': 'Waist: type a number above 0, like 82.5.'
must_not: A zero or empty value saved
The screen closed as if saved

steps.action: Clear every box, add no picture, tap Save
user_sees: Pop-up 'Nothing to save': 'Type at least one measure, or add a picture.'

start: Body screen, today already has a waist entry

steps.action: Add measures, type a new waist, tap Save
user_sees: A question naming the old value, 'That day already has these. Saving replaces them.', buttons Replace and cancel
must_not: The old value replaced without asking (past days)
Two values kept for one day

steps.action: Tap Replace; then tap the entry in History
user_sees: Sheet 'Fix this waist entry' with the new value; History line 'Tap an entry to fix or delete it.'

steps.action: Delete it in the sheet, then tap Undo on the bar
user_sees: The entry leaves History, then comes back with the same day and value
must_not: Undo bringing back a different value
A gym-recorded entry deletable by the member

start: Member signed in with Google, linked to a gym

steps.action: Save a waist entry, then open Settings, Your gym, What my gym can see
user_sees: 'MettleUp never sends your body weight, photos or notes.'
must_not: The member's own measurement sent to the gym or shown in the panel

user_sees: It leaves History; the cloud copy loses it too
must_not: The deleted entry back after the next sync or on a second phone

steps.action: Look at an entry the trainer recorded
user_sees: It is marked with the gym's name; 'Ask your gym to change the ones they recorded.'
must_not: The member able to change the gym's entry
